next.reason: 1985 Permanent Error: 'The input-output statement was unsuccessfully executed as the result of an error that precluded further processing of the file. Any specified exception procedures are executed. The permanent error condition remains in effect for all subsequent input-output operations on the file unless an implementor-defined technique is invoked'. §2023:9.1.13.1 repeats this word for word (prose, no catalog row). Catalogued carriers: the 3x values 1985 also lists in §1985:VII.1.3.5 (30, 34, 35, 37, 39), §2023:9.1.13.6 GR1 'A permanent error exists and no further information is available' and GR3 to GR7, and USE procedures run 'upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR6). §2023:9.1.13.6 GR2 (status 31, 'the data-name specified in the USING phrase of the file control entry') is NOT a carrier: 1985 has no status 31 and its ASSIGN clause names only 'implementor-name-1 or literal-1' (§1985:VII.2.3.4 GR3), so no 1985 program reaches it (band-85 adjudication 2026-11-10). The fatal-status action (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR7, §2023:14.6.13.1.3 GR3) is the 1985 critical-error preamble, not this rule. Same requirement.
